message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | State |
|--------|-------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| George Washington | Virginia |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| Roger Sherman | Connecticut |
| William Paca | Maryland |
| James Wilson | Pennsylvania |

(For a complete list, you can refer to the official records or the National Archives.)

The question is straightforward. Provide the names of the signers.
